in_marathi.name: Vibhavat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vibhavat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vibhavat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vibhava', which refers to the manifestation or appearance of a deity.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Vibhavat?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Vibhavat is 4 (ruling planet Rahu). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Vibhavat?
faq.a: Saturday is the traditional association for Vibhavat. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Vibhavat?
faq.a: Hessonite is the traditional association for Vibhavat. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Vibhavat?
faq.a: Grey, Blue are the traditional associations for Vibhavat. These are interpretive.

faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vibhavat total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
